> 第19章 皇帝赐婚（第1页）
青音青灵正要扶着陆昭菱跪下，却听她说，“公公，我伤重，头晕，跪下可能就要晕倒了，站着接旨吧。”
“晕倒了可不好接旨。”她淡淡说。
传旨官看着她包着的头，只得应了。
“奉天承运，皇帝诏曰，兹闻陆明嫡次女陆昭菱，品貌双全，温良敦厚.特许朕幼弟，赐为晋王妃，择良辰完婚，钦此。”
传旨官声音尖细，语调平平，在陆府众人前念出圣旨内容。
陆夫人五官都扭曲了，眼睛喷火，死死瞪着那圣旨，怀疑是这死太监胡说八道。
一个十三四岁的少女按捺不住叫出来。
那是陆昭云的亲妹，陆府三小姐，陆昭月。
陆昭月今天一直没有看到陆昭菱，但已经听说来了这么个二姐，她本来正闹着要去听暖楼呢，正好先来听了旨。
晋王离京的时候她还是个小屁孩，不认得晋王，但是，她最崇拜的人可是沈湘珺沈姐姐，前阵子她才听说，沈姐姐以后是要当晋王妃的。
“陆二小姐，接旨吧。”传旨官急着回宫，懒得理会其他人。
陆昭菱也没想到，太上皇刚归天，之前晋王也差点在他爹床前死掉，差一步父子俩要共赴黄泉，现在晋王就能求来赐婚圣旨。
前面还在皇上面前不认识她，说她是个小贼，偷东西偷到了宁寿宫，还让青锋跟扛猪一样把她扛出宫，现在就让她成了准晋王妃！
陆昭菱在看到陆府其他人瞪过来的各种目光时，微微一笑，上前接了圣旨。
看来她被赐婚，陆府上下都震惊生气，那她可就要接旨了。
陆昭菱接了旨，青音反应过来，立即就拿了一个小荷包塞到了传旨官手里，“多谢公公。”
虽然现在是暂时侍候陆小姐，她们也不能疏忽。
传旨官看陆府众人的反应，再看陆昭菱的惨状，本来以为这趟不会有油水，没想到陆昭菱身边的丫鬟还挺机灵。
他面色都好看了些，“咱家恭喜陆二小姐了。”
刚才被陆昭云按着的陆昭月跳了起来，对着陆昭菱叫。
“你要不要脸？凭什么你刚进京城就被赐婚？”
陆昭月长得与陆昭云有几分相似，但是身条还未长开，脸上婴儿肥未褪，但也是个小美人了。
在她旁边还有一个跟她年纪相仿的少女，纤瘦许多，看着文静。
还有一个四五岁的小男孩，虎头虎脑，正瞪大眼睛看着她。
在他们的身上，陆昭菱都能看到他们与陆明的一根牵绊，所以这应该都是陆明的子女。
陆家人的容貌倒是都挺优秀，个个都长得不错。

> Chapter 19 The Emperor Grants Marriage (Page 1)
Qingyin Qingling was about to help Lu Zhaoling kneel down, but she heard her say, "Father-in-law, I am seriously injured and dizzy. I may faint if I kneel down. Please stand and receive the order."
"It's not easy to follow orders when you faint." She said calmly.
The messenger looked at her wrapped head and had no choice but to agree.
"By God's blessing, the emperor has issued an edict. I have heard that Lu Zhaoling, the legitimate second daughter of Lu Ming, is both good-looking and gentle. I have granted my youngest brother the title of Princess Jin, and we will marry her at the right time. I express my gratitude to you."
The messenger's voice was high-pitched and his tone was flat, and he read out the content of the imperial edict in front of everyone in the Lu Mansion.
Mrs. Lu's facial features were distorted, her eyes were spitting fire, and she stared at the imperial edict, suspecting that this damn eunuch was talking nonsense.
A girl of thirteen or fourteen couldn't help shouting.
That was Lu Zhaoyun's biological sister, the third young lady of the Lu family, Lu Zhaoyue.
Lu Zhaoyue has not seen Lu Zhaoling today, but she has heard that such a second sister has arrived. She was originally planning to go to Nuan Lou, so she happened to come to hear the order first.
She was still a little kid when King Jin left the capital and didn't recognize him. However, the person she admired most was Sister Shen Xiangjun. She just heard a while ago that Sister Shen was going to be Princess Jin in the future.
"Second Miss Lu, please accept the order." The order officer was in a hurry to return to the palace and was too lazy to pay attention to the others.
Lu Zhaoling also didn't expect that the Supreme Emperor had just passed away, and the King of Jin had almost died in front of his father's bed before. The father and son were close to going to hell together, and now the King of Jin would be able to ask for a marriage decree.
He didn't recognize her in front of the emperor, and said she was a thief who stole things into Ningshou Palace. He also asked Qingfeng to carry her out of the palace like a pig, and now he made her a prospective princess!
When Lu Zhaoling saw the various looks from other people in the Lu family, he smiled slightly and stepped forward to receive the imperial edict.
It seems that she was granted a marriage, and everyone in the Lu family was shocked and angry, so she would have to accept the decree.
Lu Zhaoling accepted the order, and Qingyin reacted and immediately took a small purse and stuffed it into the hand of the order officer, "Thank you, father-in-law."
Although they are currently serving Miss Lu temporarily, they cannot neglect her.
The messenger looked at the reactions of everyone in the Lu family and looked at Lu Zhaoling's tragic situation. He originally thought that there would be no trouble in this trip, but he didn't expect that the maids around Lu Zhaoling were quite clever.
His face looked better, "Congratulations to Miss Lu Er."
Lu Zhaoyue, who was held down by Lu Zhaoyun just now, jumped up and shouted to Lu Zhaoling.
"Do you want to be shameless? Why did you get married as soon as you entered the capital?"
Lu Zhaoyue looks somewhat similar to Lu Zhaoyun, but her figure has not yet grown out and the baby fat on her face has not faded away, but she is still a little beauty.
Next to her was a girl of similar age to her, who was much slimmer and looked Wen Jing.
There was also a little boy of four or five years old, with a tiger-like head and a thick head, looking at her with wide eyes.
In them, Lu Zhaoling could see a connection between them and Lu Ming, so they should all be Lu Ming's children.
The appearance of the Lu family is quite outstanding, and everyone is good-looking.
